name: Hand-Painted Colorful Acrylic Calligraphy
short_desc: Brighten your home with this expressive impressionist Islamic artwork featuring Dua-e-Yunus (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka...). Hand-painted in elegant black calligraphy over a multi-colored pastel watercolor backdrop and edged with shimmering gold leaf, this framed piece brings joy, hope, and artistic warmth to living rooms and boho-chic interiors.
seo_title: Pastel Impressionist Dua-e-Yunus Islamic Art – Hand-Painted Colorful Acrylic Calligraphy with Gold Leaf
description:
Infuse joy, hope, and vibrant light into your living space with this breathtaking impressionist Islamic artwork. The piece features the comforting Quranic prayer Dua-e-Yunus ("La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin"), rendered in fluid, masterfully proportioned black Arabic script across the center of the composition.

Handcrafted using high-grade acrylic paints applied in a soft, dabbing sponge-brush technique, the background creates a dreamlike watercolor effect. A rich palette of pastel pink, sky blue, lemon yellow, mint green, and lilac lavender blends seamlessly together, encased within a dramatic dark border and embellished with shimmering gold leaf accents along the inner margins.

To protect the artwork's delicate pastel tones and ensure long-lasting durability, it is finished with a protective gloss varnish seal. This protective layer shields the acrylic paint layers from dust, humidity, and UV fading over time while enhancing the depth of the gold leaf under ambient room light.

Enclosed within a sleek dark walnut frame, this colorful centerpiece hangs effortlessly above sofas, console tables, or accent walls, making it a perfect fit for modern bohemian living rooms, family lounges, or contemporary gallery spaces.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints with gold leaf leafing

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for color preservation and light enhancement

Theme & Script: Dua-e-Yunus (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin)

Color Palette: Soft pastel multi-color blend (pink, yellow, blue, green, lilac), crisp black script, dark border, and metallic gold leaf detailing

Style: Expressionist Pastel / Modern Boho-Chic Islamic Calligraphy

Ideal Placement: Sofa backdrop, living room feature wall, boho lounge, or brightly lit family room
